in_arabic.name: بہادر

in_urdu.name: بہادر
in_urdu.meaning: شجاعت، بہادری، ستر، بہادر مرد، کامیاب، سروری
in_urdu.long_meaning: بہادر نام کا مطلب ہے شجاعت، بہادری، ستر، بہادر مرد، کامیاب، سروری، یہ نام اسلام کے زمانہ سے ہی مشہور ناں ہے، اور اس کے بارے میں کہا جاتا ہے کہ بہادری کی نشانی ہے۔ اس نام کی شجاعت کی وجہ سے اسے بہادر کا نام دیا گیا، اور یہ نام بہت سے مسلمانوں کے لئے کامیاب ہے۔

data.cultural_impact: The name Bahadur is deeply rooted in Islamic and South Asian cultures, where bravery and courage are highly valued virtues. This name was often bestowed upon individuals who demonstrated exceptional valor in battle or in everyday life. The name Bahadur is also common among military personnel and law enforcement officials in countries like Pakistan and India, as a mark of respect and recognition for their bravery and service to their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Bahadur holds a deeper spiritual significance as a reminder of the inner strength and courage that every believer should strive to possess. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger." (Al-Tirmidhi). Thus, the name Bahadur serves as a constant reminder for Muslims to develop the inner strength to overcome their own desires and passions, and remain steadfast in their faith and commitment to God.
